data.text:
# Unparked, with the gate reading the right ticket

SEEN-101 delivered and is merged. `state_for` now finds this ticket by its id, reports
`ticket_source: found by id`, and reads the ticket that asks for codegraph alone.

The clarify record at record 8 is unchanged and stands. Re-asked through the fixed code it scores 0.79,
against the 0.46 it scored while the gate was reading the pre-split ticket, recorded in SEEN-101's
journal at record 6. It is still a hundredth short of 0.8, and it is not being re-advanced: clarify was
cleared by decision at record 7 and a cleared stage is not re-litigated because a later measurement
came out close.

What happens next is the solution record, which was written before the park and sits in
`.harness-drafts/SEEN-096-solution.json`. The rename fix that was briefly a fifth criterion here has
shipped in SEEN-101, so that draft's first half is now history rather than plan, and it is rewritten to
describe codegraph alone before it is submitted.
